author: Leslie Hansen
text:
Lanebridge Logistics is a truckload brokerage company that arranges for 
equipment and drivers to pick up and deliver loads on behalf of shippers.  We 
have a large network of vetted carriers who are available to Lanebridge 
Logistics for capacity and who are willing to accept loads on short notice.  
We can usually arrange for equipment to pick up loads within a couple of 
days' notice.  We do not own any equipment ourselves.

For this reason, we can only quote a price for a load on a non-binding basis.  
However, we can provide you with a guaranteed capacity and we can guarantee 
the price of the load.  This is advantageous to you because you do not have 
to worry about capacity issues or fluctuating freight rates, and you do not 
have to worry about losing money if the price of fuel rises dramatically 
during the course of a shipment.  The only caveat is that you must use 
Lanebridge Logistics as your exclusive broker for that particular load.  We 
will not be able to arrange for equipment from our network of carriers if we 
are not your exclusive broker for that load.

Please let me know if you would like to proceed on this basis.  I will send 
you a letter of intent to this effect and we can then proceed to confirm 
capacity and pricing for your load.  Please let me know if you have any 
questions or concerns.

Leslie
